title: Explain, Then Forget: Recommendation Unlearning under Asymmetric Access Constraint
abstract: arXiv:2610.40658v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recommendation unlearning aims to remove the influence of specific historical interactions that should no longer affect future recommendations, such as noisy clicks or outdated user preferences. However, performing recommendation unlearning becomes much harder in modern Machine-Learning-as-a-Service (MLaaS) architectures, where the recommendation model is remotely hosted by a model provider (MP) and accessed by service operators (SO) only through APIs. In this setting, a service operator serves end users but cannot access or modify internal model parameters. As a result, existing unlearning methods are difficult to apply because they require access to model internals for retraining, fine-tuning, or other parameter updates. To address these challenges, we propose Causal Explanation-based Unlearning (CEU), a novel unlearning framework tailored for MLaaS environments. translated_title: 解释，然后遗忘：非对称访问约束下的推荐遗忘学习
translated_abstract: 推荐遗忘学习旨在消除那些不应再影响未来推荐的特定历史交互（如噪声点击或过时的用户偏好）所带来的影响。然而，在现代机器学习即服务架构中，执行推荐遗忘变得困难得多，因为推荐模型由模型提供商远程托管，服务运营商只能通过API进行访问。在这种设置下，服务运营商为最终用户提供服务，但无法访问或修改内部模型参数。因此，现有的遗忘方法难以应用，因为它们需要访问模型内部才能进行重新训练、微调或其他参数更新。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了基于因果解释的遗忘方法（CEU），这是一种专为MLaaS环境量身定制的新型遗忘框架。CEU不修改内部模型权重，而是通过两阶段（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了CEU（基于因果解释的遗忘）框架，在不修改模型参数的情况下，通过因果解释机制实现了服务运营商仅能通过API访问模型的MLaaS环境下的推荐遗忘学习。
en_tdlr: Proposes CEU (Causal Explanation-based Unlearning), a novel framework that achieves recommendation unlearning in MLaaS environments through causal explanation rather than modifying model parameters, overcoming the constraint that service operators cannot access model internals.
